stem:
The side lengths of the base of a triangular prism are 5 meters, 8 meters, and 10 meters. The height of the prism is 16.5 meters.

What is the lateral surface area of the prism in square meters?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
